alt: 孩子們開始園藝前，先圍著畫有澆水、收工具與共用鏟子三幅圖的板子握手約定，右側三幅小景顯示大家隨後依約合作。
scene_prompt: Before starting a shared garden activity, four children gather and agree together on simple common rules displayed as exactly three PICTOGRAMS on a board: a watering can beside a sprout, tools returned to a basket, and two hands sharing a small shovel. One child presents the picture board while the others nod and extend hands together in agreement; their gardening tools are still neatly waiting unused. A small secondary vignette at right shows the same children then watering, tidying tools and sharing fairly according to that agreement. No letters, numerals, writing or prohibition signs.
